title: The Long Last Tend

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A house keeps what it cannot pay for: a count in wood, a crack in a pot, and a word that stands in no doorway to be asked. None of them asks who paid for the keeping.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of Low Kiln, in the dark month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and fifty-one to three hundred and fifty-three days, six months and one hundred and seventy-one to one hundred and seventy-three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, as in chapters 25 through 99. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it, with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and fifty-one, fifty-two and fifty-three days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources. The heard bell — four, four and a gap — stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night. Eight arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, Ash's first and Ash's second — stand behind one unsigned figure, eight are eight and not one account, both of Ash's subtractions locked and unread in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and never promoted into a doctrine.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Second Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{351}{Ash 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 276 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, and carry 350 to 351 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy to one hundred and seventy-one days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 351 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). No recap: nothing from Ash 19, 20 or 21 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the reading on the twentieth bought no lesson under this roof, and the eight arithmetics stand locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box, eight are eight and not one account, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of eight (T015/T041/T047 held). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread of drool frozen and unwiped, nobody under any roof having been given an instruction about the thread; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire. The infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels with the surgeon's knowing, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar: Sella to the fire before the basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, *The house will keep it*, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079/T100). In the small hours the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold — answer 277, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082). Ash 30 (Day 359) stands six mornings ahead and is named only as a date; no ninth arithmetic early.

scenes.title: The Yard's Seven Places
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 22 through the going of the light and the bed, at the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva (once at the well, pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold with its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam, answering *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* with her hand to her sleeve and the notched birch strip unread, the ninth record-first hand nine with no tenth and expressly not the speaker of any voice); walk-ons (a Cold Acre hare-carrier sending the price to the weather and going toward the clay road with the hare unweighed, a cracked-jar man sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year will want, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late); Garl in objects. No Berr, no Hessa, no runner, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell, no ownerless voice on the twenty-second. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven places with a look and no number — the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called thaw unswept both, the space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the trough's skin, the field's empty place on the worked strips, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085); dressed grain turned once under wool with no figure, fingers in and out without closing, no handful (T077). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath at the sill, finding each where it was put and not made again — not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping, not the calling of the loan, with no payer standing — brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead, gives the back-room men no name, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one piece of iron with two bites, holding and taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates neither given nor withdrawn while the claim goes on gathering interest (T062/T035/T031). The whole file is checked and left as it lay: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, eight arithmetics eight and not one account with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box (T015/T041/T047, T078, T061/T082). Burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, row five askings, Ash 5 joining and Ash 17 direction held apart with a finger between; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth, a third, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping or a witness (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). At the going of the light the widow's mark is untouched and the pot rim stands two inches beyond the reaching hand; in the small hours the hand goes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds it whole on the note's own finishing, comes down and lays itself back on answer 278, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Third Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{352}{Ash 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap; carry 278 honest answers on the sixth place, eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that with a finger between, none a sixth, the burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 direction held apart, the well-saying at four shapings and the runner's writing still turned toward herself and unread (T080 held). Carry 351 to 352 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-one to one hundred and seventy-two days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 352 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust gone stiffer and browner in the dry kiln heat, corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside. The surgeon/infant quarrel renewed — crust lifted two inches, thread wiped, hand on the pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). Weather texture of the dark month's last tend: a harder cold, the trough skin thick enough to hold a poured spoon, the river's note lower under the finger's-width door, all entered nowhere (T083/T085). In the small hours the hand goes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back on answer 279, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Direction Over the Boards
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry and the chapter's one meaningful change, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 23 through the going of the light and the bed, at the Clay Yard's seven places, the rack end, the boards, the wheel-shed edge and the damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons as the yard goes about its ordinary work; no Ilva on this day, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector, no market, Cross or bell. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):** in the afternoon an ownerless voice comes over the boards from the direction of Slate Row — a word shaping the joining of the burned slate and the shut room further: a room shut with the damper closed and a slate burned over a man nobody named, and a low direction that the room was shut against the cold and the slate burned so a count would not go up, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date and nobody standing in any doorway to be asked. Weather answers first and the price of barley after it, and the voice goes up the terrace. The boy files it on a place of its own **beside** the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 direction with a finger between every pair, a further shaping of that joining and an advancement of the finding that a place wants a witness and a witness is a day somebody stands somewhere and can be asked; it is expressly **not** a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stays at five), **not** a third shut-room telling (which stays at two), **not** a sixth asking of the row (which stays at five), **not** a fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying (which stays at four), **not** a hearing, **not** a seventh of the full note, **not** a cause, **not** a confession, **not** a reader, **not** a name, **not** a witness and **not** a payment, with no payer standing under it. He does not join it to Ilva's strip, Hessa's turned writing, Berr's box, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate, the charcoal beneath the shelf, the covered grain or the handful; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between. Jorra grows quieter when the direction goes around and the household straightens around the quiet without an order; Sella gives it no name, no figure and no lesson, and the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together is still far off and is not his. The yard's seven places are gone around with a look and no number, the three coverings stay weather, the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured, the hunts and repairs stay directions answered with the weather, the pot and the carrying arm; Tarn keeps six and the seventh, checks the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting and does not make either again, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006); Jorra parts dusty from clean forearms, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light the widow's mark is untouched; in the small hours the hand goes up, takes a small intake, holds it whole on the note's own finishing and lays itself back on answer 280, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Also advanced and not paid: T071/T072 (352 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-two days), T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T078, T015/T041/T047 held. No sixth arithmetic, sixth hearing, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping came due.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{353}{Ash 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap; carry 280 honest answers, eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 23 direction standing on its own place beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 direction with a finger between every pair, still gathering and still unspent, with no witness, no sixth, no third shut-room telling, no sixth asking and no fifth shaping. Carry 352 to 353 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-two to one hundred and seventy-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 353 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: the crust leathery and two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, the composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath the finger, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). Weather texture of the dark month's last tend: the trough skin thick, the river's note lower under the finger's-width door, the carried fire keeping four and a gap under the floor, the kiln cold behind the wall — all entered nowhere (T083/T085, T088). In the small hours the hand goes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back on answer 281, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Ash 30 (Day 359) stands six mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never as a promise.

scenes.title: What the Ash Kept
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 24 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons: the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather and going toward the clay road with the hare unweighed, the cracked-jar man sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year will want, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice on the twenty-fourth — the direction of the twenty-third does not repeat and stands where it was put. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted; hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085, T077, T098). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where it was put and not made again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check; the five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that stay objects on their own places and none is made a sixth, a seventh, a habit or a rule (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one piece of iron with two bites, holding and taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the claim goes on gathering interest (T062/T035/T031). The whole file is checked and left as it lay: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, the heard bell four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, eight arithmetics of the year — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, Ash's first and second — behind one unsigned figure, eight are eight and not one account, both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine standing up out of eight; nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid, none spent, named, joined, promoted into a witness, a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a reader, a cause or a payment (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). The far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together is still far off and is not his. At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed, thread left frozen; she tells the coals it is the thaw and *The house will keep it*, leaves the charcoal unread, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand. The widow's mark hangs where it hangs and is not touched — a going of the light and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer 282, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. Three hundred and fifty-three stand exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody; six months and one hundred and seventy-three days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; and Garl's name is unspoken the same number. Nothing on the twenty-fourth has been opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. Ash keeps its twenty-fourth day without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; Ash 30 (Day 359) stands six mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never as a promise, and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; no ninth arithmetic is supplied early, no seventh opening made due, no sixth hearing, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping invented to make a row come out even. The keeping of the number is the only honest work there has been to do, bought nothing at two inches of air, was not for sale, and goes on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. Forward, not closed.
